conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I got a fraud alert on my card! Some ₹20,000 transaction I didn’t make!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: That’s concerning, sir. I’ll block your card immediately to prevent further misuse. Can you confirm the last four digits of your card?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s seven eight six six. I’m really worried… how did this happen?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Your card is now blocked, and you’re safe. The transaction seems unauthorized. I’ll file a fraud report and issue a replacement card.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Thank you, but what about my money? Will I get it back?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: We’ll initiate a chargeback request. You should see the refund in 7-10 days, and I’ll follow up personally.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I appreciate that. Please keep me updated.
